urdu.name: منور

persian.name: منور

faq.q: What is the origin of Munawar?
faq.a: Munawar is associated with Arabic. Munawar is Arabic مُنَوَّر (Munawwar) 'illuminated, radiant', from the root ن و ر (n-w-r). The source gloss 'Beloved, Adored' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense.

faq.q: What does Munawar mean in Persian?

faq.q: What are the variants of Munawar?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Munawar, munawar. Script forms are منور, مُنَوَّر, मुनव्वर.

faq.q: Is Munawar a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
